subject: Only require PuTTYNG end anchors to follow their start anchor
body:
Only require PuTTYNG end anchors to follow their start anchor

The strict check rejected window.c: sfree(title); occurs six times, and
requiring exactly one match is only correct for a start anchor, which has to
identify one place unambiguously. An end anchor just delimits the block and is
matched at its first occurrence after the start, as upstream does.

Still fatal when the end anchor never occurs after the start.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
patch:
--- .github/workflows/Build_PuTTYNG.yml
@@ -55,21 +55,24 @@ jobs:
             }
           }
 
+          # The start anchor must identify one place unambiguously. The end anchor only has to occur
+          # somewhere after it: `sfree(title);` legitimately appears six times in window.c, and the
+          # block ends at the first one following the start.
           function Replace-Block([string]$File, [string]$StartAnchor, [string]$EndAnchor, [string]$NewBlock) {
             $content = Get-Content -Path $File -Raw
             Assert-Anchor $content $StartAnchor $File
-            Assert-Anchor $content $EndAnchor $File
 
             $startIndex = $content.IndexOf($StartAnchor) + $StartAnchor.Length + 1
             $endIndex = $content.IndexOf($EndAnchor, $startIndex)
-            if ($endIndex -lt $startIndex) {
-              Write-Host "ERROR: end anchor precedes start anchor in $File" -ForegroundColor Red
+            if ($endIndex -lt 0) {
+              Write-Host "ERROR: end anchor never occurs after the start anchor in $File" -ForegroundColor Red
+              Write-Host "       end anchor: $EndAnchor" -ForegroundColor Red
               exit 1
             }
 
             $modified = $content.Remove($startIndex, $endIndex - $startIndex).Insert($startIndex, $NewBlock)
             Set-Content -Path $File -Value $modified
-            Write-Host "Patched block in $File" -ForegroundColor Green
+            Write-Host "Patched block in $File (removed $($endIndex - $startIndex) chars)" -ForegroundColor Green
           }
 
           # --- cmdline.c: accept -hwndparent (embedding) and -auth-plugin ---
